NG Case Views

Ten individual exhaustion events across October 2, 3, 17 and 18, 2023, each in five coordinated views on one time axis (seconds from t0), with the same ids throughout: the detector t0, the archived candidate id and its recognition clock, onset and confirmation, and every dated row in the window. Views 2 and 3 zoom to t0-120 to t0+180 s; views 1, 4 and 5 run the full t0-300 to t0+600 s. Hover any mark for its row. Nothing here is a trade.
